# DocBox

> DocBox is an open registry of tested, executable recipes for game engines (currently Godot).
> Every recipe is human-verified, ships with acceptance tests, failure modes, and runnable GDScript
> code. DocBox exists so AI agents can produce correct code instead of hallucinating fragments
> scraped from forums. This file follows the llmstxt.org standard.

## Recipes (machine-readable)

- [recipes.json](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/recipes.json): canonical structured catalog
  with `min_engine_version`, `requires`, `conflicts`, `verification`, and per-recipe URLs.

## Recipes (human-readable)

- [2D Character Movement (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-2d-movement.md): move and jump with CharacterBody2D and move_and_slide. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Camera Follow (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-camera-follow.md): native Camera2D smoothing with world limits. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Save/Load Games with JSON (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-save-load-json.md): persist state with FileAccess and JSON to user://. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Scene Transitions (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-scene-transition.md): change_scene_to_file with error checks and a fade effect. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Tweens (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-tween.md): chained, parallel and looping animations with create_tween. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Audio Playback (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-audio.md): looping music and SFX with pitch variance. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Rocket Physics (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-rocket.md): thrust-based motion on RigidBody3D with fuel burn. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Input Buffer (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-input-buffer.md): buffer jump presses before landing for responsive controls. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Object Pooling (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-object-pooling.md): recycle bullets/particles with acquire/release, no GC pressure. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Simple State Machine (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-state-machine.md): idle/run/jump states with enum and match. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Typewriter Dialogue (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-dialogue.md): RichTextLabel typewriter with a finished signal. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.
- [Custom Signals (FA)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/fa/recipes/godot-signals.md): decouple player and HUD with health_changed. Status: human-verified. Engine: Godot 4.x.

## English mirrors

All recipes above are mirrored in English under
`https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/en/recipes/<recipe-id>.md` — for example:
[2D Character Movement (EN)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/en/recipes/godot-2d-movement.md),
[Rocket Physics (EN)](https://esfandteam.github.io/docbox/en/recipes/godot-rocket.md).
